name: quicksilver
lore_descriptor: flowing silver that hardens only when wielded
unidentified_descriptor: a weapon that seems to shimmer
first_pickup_chronicle: Quicksilver — alchemists' silver. The metal flows in the forge but locks in the hand. It will not hold a strike unless you mean it; for a careful wielder, it teaches its own dances.
design_notes: Fills pf 52 gap. Finesse-friendly: lower damage_mult (0.95) but very light + magical (max_enchant 6). Slightly weaker raw, but huge enchant ceiling.
